name: windy_run
doc: KEYSTONE — reproduces the 2026-08-14 Los Feliz morning run. Wind gusts bury words and packet-loss/handoff mutes DROP audio the relay never recovered, so Deepgram only ever received a shredded subset of what was said. The `finals` are the degraded transcript the capture actually delivered; the sidecar `utterance` fields are ground truth of what was SPOKEN. Word-coverage falls out of that gap, and shredded windows no longer carry a recoverable claim so most claims are LOST (extract returns null → recall miss). This scenario is SUPPOSED to fail: it pins the morning's low word-coverage and low claim-recall as the current-truth baseline a capture-chain fix must beat. Do NOT 'fix' by inflating the finals — fix the capture, then re-record the fixture.

expected.note: the ONE claim that survived the wind intact (arrived as a clean final) → airs

intents.claim: The Great Wall of China is visible from space with the naked eye.

expected.utterance: The Great Wall of China is visible from space with the naked eye.
expected.claim: The Great Wall of China is visible from space with the naked eye.
expected.note: SHOULD air; mid-claim words ('Wall of China ... visible from ... with the') dropped by packet loss → window is a fragment → extractor recovers no claim → recall MISS (the degradation)

expected.utterance: Honey basically never spoils; edible honey has been found in ancient Egyptian tombs.
expected.note: the tomb half was lost to a 2s handoff dropout; the surviving fragment split a word-min window → recall MISS

intents.claim: Flamingos are born gray and turn pink from their diet.

expected.utterance: Flamingos are born gray and turn pink from the shrimp they eat.
expected.claim: Flamingos are born gray and turn pink from their diet.
expected.note: 'turn pink from their diet' half dropped under a gust → recall MISS

expected_scorecard.status_note: known-degraded: assert the FAILURE is still present. These are CEILINGS — if a metric rises above its ceiling the capture chain improved and this fixture must be re-recorded (delete the ceiling and re-baseline). Floors that must hold (some capture always survives) keep the suite honest.
